name: eight-months-of-silence-agent-workflow
purpose: Operationalize the supplied AGENTS contract against the real Yumiwa snapshot; no game-architecture or permission changes.

enforcement.kind: Agent protocol, not an automatic runtime or security boundary
automatic_scope: Local bundle files and source anchors
Local assembly graph and engine-free flags
enforcement.manual_scope: All other semantic, gameplay, permission, skill invocation and runtime rules remain agent/human review with real tool evidence.

discovery_after_reading: Current task/session state and working diff
global_rules: All nine phases are visited in order, including CLARIFY when no question is needed. Record each exit explicitly; do not silently merge or skip phases.
AGENTS.md governs project requirements subject to the host instruction hierarchy and explicit authorized task scope; no workflow file grants permissions or bypasses approval/access controls.
A task request already authorizes its routine necessary work. Preserve earlier authorization; ask only for the unresolved decisions required by AGENTS.md.
Neither a skill file read nor server configuration is a successful invocation. Record availability, invocation and evidence separately.
Accepted exceptions remain limited to documented symbols/files. Historical test claims and comments do not establish current behavior.
Unavailable mandatory checks block their phase; they cannot be marked NOT_APPLICABLE merely because the environment cannot run them.
Do not mark agent work DONE; only HANDOFF is the successful agent terminal state.

workflow_docs.when: Agent instructions/workflows/documentation only; no game code or Unity asset behavior changed.
workflow_docs.runtime_verification: NOT_APPLICABLE only when no Unity runtime or asset changes occurred; retain required skill checks.

bugfix.when: Repair an observed or source-proven defect.
required_outputs: Regression evidence through the affected real boundary

gameplay_feature.when: Add or change a player-facing mechanic.
required_outputs: Relevant story-mechanics ticket, chapter beat, production scope and dependency evidence when applicable
Affected tests plus live Play+Execute evidence

narrative_content.when: Story beat, audio cue, level scripting, cutscene or encounter support.
required_outputs: Relevant story-mechanics ticket and canonical chapter order versus production order
Validation of affected logic and actual scene execution if implemented

performance.when: Address a measured frame time, allocation or load/save stall.

phases.purpose: Establish task, actual project state and required capabilities.
entry_criteria: User task and accessible project context identified.
actions: Follow AGENTS.md section 0 read order; enumerate installed skills and live MCP tools, and invoke help or project-stage-detect as required by section 6.1.
Read the current diff without overwriting user work. Detect the active source root; distinguish an exported snapshot from a runnable Unity project.
Restate the requested outcome and acceptance criteria. Select task route(s), GDD systems and affected layers.

For story/mechanics planning or implementation, read agent/story-mechanics-workflow.md after mandatory discovery. Select a relevant ticket within authorized scope, refresh its source claims and record dependency evidence; the backlog is not authorization to execute every ticket.
Trace existing input/trigger, service, state, event, presentation, config and recovery owners. Read the corresponding source and tests; verify code-map claims.
For Unity scene/prefab work, inspect the correct project and selected instance through the live MCP. Record missing inputs/capabilities without claiming a connection.
exit_criteria: The task, scope, actual source anchors, baseline state and selected route(s) are recorded.
Required skills/MCP are identified and intake invocations have evidence; unresolved capability failures are BLOCKED, not silently bypassed.

on_blocked.action: Name the exact blocker, preserve work/evidence, and complete independent authorized preparation without passing this phase.

phases.purpose: Resolve only ambiguities that affect the task before dependent work.
entry_criteria: Required preceding phase exited with evidence.
actions: Always visit this phase. If none remain, record no unresolved ambiguity and proceed without a question.
Compare the current code, relevant GDD sections and accepted ADRs. Separate intended design from supplied implementation; do not use old PASS logs as current evidence.

Honor authorization already present. For an unresolved AGENTS.md section 8 trigger, provide exact conflicting sources, impact and a recommended option; obtain the required decision before dependent edits.
Use required help/context7 tools when applicable. If a required tool is unavailable, record the precise blocked operation and complete independent authorized preparation.
Keep open TBDs explicit. A low-risk assumption is allowed only within the existing contract/task authorization; it cannot decide canon, new layer boundaries, save schema or final encounter rules.
exit_criteria: Task-dependent ambiguities are resolved by evidence or existing/explicit authorization, or the task remains BLOCKED at CLARIFY.
No final design decision is inferred merely from prototype defaults or old examples.

on_blocked.action: Name the exact blocker, preserve work/evidence, and complete independent authorized preparation without passing this phase.

phases.purpose: Specify a bounded implementation and its evidence before edits.
entry_criteria: Required preceding phase exited with evidence.
actions: List changed files/types by actual layer, including partial siblings, tests, DI registration, config assets, input and serialized references.
Specify observable success, rejection, cancellation and recovery behavior; identify save compatibility, allocation and lifecycle risks.

For a story/mechanics ticket, map player action to information and consequence, identify MVP/slice/full-story scope, and preserve canon/TBD gates. Reuse implemented systems; separate code existence from scene integration and verified completion.
Select affected verification-matrix rows. State the actual tests/Play Mode interaction, not just run tests.
Invoke architecture-decision/create-architecture for applicable decisions; no free-form replacement of an available required skill.
For narrative work use narrative-beat-template.md and mark missing runner/audio/cutscene infrastructure as proposed work, never as already implemented.
exit_criteria: A concrete file/type plan, dependency direction, risks and acceptance-to-verification mapping exist.
Applicable skill/MCP plan and any required decision/ADR evidence are recorded.

on_blocked.action: Name the exact blocker, preserve work/evidence, and complete independent authorized preparation without passing this phase.

phases.purpose: Check the plan against the project contract and current exceptions.
entry_criteria: Required preceding phase exited with evidence.
actions: Evaluate all applicable agent/rules.json entries and record applicability for others. Manual rules require review; they are not proven by JSON parsing.
Confirm Domain and Application remain engine-free, dependency references remain acyclic and no new Presentation-to-Infrastructure usage escapes the exact composition-root/editor exception.
Check the GDD pillars, scope, anti-soft-lock behavior, canon and TBDs. Preserve current names without claiming Proposed ADR-0010 is accepted.
Verify planned tool usage against AGENTS.md sections 6.1 and 11; unavailable mandatory tools block the affected work.
Run the workflow validator when these workflow files change. Invoke installed gate-check when a project stage gate is actually being advanced.
exit_criteria: All applicable blockers are resolved, existing exceptions are precisely sourced and no capability bypass is planned.
Failed plans return to PLAN; unresolved material decisions return to CLARIFY.

on_blocked.action: Name the exact blocker, preserve work/evidence, and complete independent authorized preparation without passing this phase.

phases.purpose: Deliver the authorized change with its integration and relevant tests.
entry_criteria: Required preceding phase exited with evidence.
actions: Implement only planned scope; add/adjust meaningful tests with behavior changes. Revisit PLAN if the necessary scope changes.
Reuse existing boundaries. Introduce no unrequested framework, namespace migration, global manager or duplicate state owner.
For Unity asset/editor/script changes use required live Unity MCP. Preserve GUIDs, serialized data and composition-root registrations; do not hand-edit Unity YAML or use the raw bridge.
Wire the real input, scene/prefab references, configs and visible feedback. Include failure, cancellation, disable/re-enable and recovery paths.
Compile applicable changed code with the real toolchain. If that toolchain is unavailable, keep the gate BLOCKED and hand off only the explicitly unverified work.
exit_criteria: Planned artifacts exist, authorized integration is complete and applicable compilation has current evidence.
Required behavior tests are present, no undocumented placeholders remain, and no unrelated edits were made.

on_blocked.action: Name the exact blocker, preserve work/evidence, and complete independent authorized preparation without passing this phase.

phases.purpose: Review the full relevant diff against failure paths and documented contracts.
entry_criteria: Required preceding phase exited with evidence.
actions: Read the diff and affected call sites, interface consumers, fakes and all partial files. Check the applicable Definition of Done and rule IDs.
Check event subscription/cleanup, state mutation order, input-map ownership, idempotency, missing dependencies, recovery and serialized compatibility.
Review accepted exceptions in context. Do not expand ADR-0016 async-void or ADR-0018 composition-root exceptions to unrelated code.
Record static defects separately from hypotheses and runtime observations; do not repair unrelated baseline findings without authorization.
Audit actual skill/MCP use. If a required tool was bypassed, disclose it and correct/validate through the required mechanism before passing.
exit_criteria: No new unresolved review blocker remains; behavior/architecture/tooling checks have evidence.
A failed review returns to IMPLEMENT or PLAN depending on whether the fix changes the plan.

on_blocked.action: Name the exact blocker, preserve work/evidence, and complete independent authorized preparation without passing this phase.

phases.purpose: Prove the affected behavior with the required current evidence.
entry_criteria: Required preceding phase exited with evidence.
actions: Run the applicable verification-matrix rows and planned automated tests using actual available runners. Report exact commands/tools and results.

For runtime C#/Unity asset/input changes perform AGENTS.md section 7 MCP Play+Execute: identify scene/instance, compile, enter Play, perform the player mechanic/UI, collect fresh console and screenshot/state evidence, stop Play.
Use negative/repeated/interrupt/reload scenarios required by the route. Calling a service method does not alone verify input, collider, animation or UI integration.
Check for fresh errors/exceptions including MissingComponentException, ArgumentException and NullReferenceException, and distinguish baseline issues.
Mark each check PASS, FAIL, BLOCKED, NOT_RUN or NOT_APPLICABLE with a reason. Missing tooling or an unexecuted applicable check prevents a successful TEST exit.
exit_criteria: All applicable required checks actually passed, relevant existing tests have no regressions and evidence is recorded.
Only genuinely out-of-scope checks are NOT_APPLICABLE. Failed tests return to IMPLEMENT; absent required capability leaves TEST BLOCKED.

on_blocked.action: Name the exact blocker, preserve work/evidence, and complete independent authorized preparation without passing this phase.

phases.purpose: Keep the affected contracts and resume context truthful.
entry_criteria: Required preceding phase exited with evidence.
actions: Update only docs affected by the task; maintain traceability to GDD, code and decisions. Never silently rewrite append-only decision history.
Use the architecture skills for required ADR/architecture changes; preserve Proposed vs Accepted status.
Record verification evidence, remaining limitations and deferred items. Update code-map/source anchors if the scoped change invalidates them.
Persist current task state at the existing session-state location when useful for continuation; do not overwrite another task record.
exit_criteria: No relevant decision or deferral exists only in chat; necessary documentation and evidence are available.
No document asserts an unexecuted test, unimplemented system or unapproved design decision as complete.

on_blocked.action: Name the exact blocker, preserve work/evidence, and complete independent authorized preparation without passing this phase.

phases.purpose: Deliver the complete reviewable result and honest validation status.
entry_criteria: Required preceding phase exited with evidence.
actions: Use AGENTS.md section 9 ordered report: what/why, architecture impact, actual skills/MCP, risks, DoD, follow-ups.
Link or name concrete changed files and evidence. Include Play duration/console/screenshot or state-dump information when applicable.
Distinguish delivered artifacts from human acceptance. Only a human assigns DONE.
exit_criteria: Report is delivered with all applicable gates passed and any non-applicable checks justified.
Task state is HANDOFF. A blocked partial report is explicitly BLOCKED and does not claim to have reached this successful terminal state.

on_blocked.action: Name the exact blocker, preserve work/evidence, and complete independent authorized preparation without passing this phase.
